'''Luxury Stars''' was an outworld resort advertized across the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]] during the wars between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Posters promoting the resort were seen on multiple worlds including [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
